ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZWjIvQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhC94_M", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 59, "title": "Add distinct DAISIZEN library reading and OSL catalog journeys", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `2f591ac0ee34e0962936429ef984da5fe15745b5`, enter `13 → 2 → LIBRARY` or `13 → 2 → OSL`. Both services display the same empty file list. `src/sections.ts` maps both to `files`; `src/navigation.ts` permits redisplay and return but no category or content browsing.

This preserves the earlier placeholder scope but loses an evidenced distinction: DAISIZEN's library offered reading categories, while OSL organized software and data. Neither service currently provides a meaningful visit beyond its landing screen.

## Expected outcome

Provide two complete, keyboard-operated, read-only browser-local journeys:

- DAISIZEN → LIBRARY → category → original article → category → library directory → SIG.
- DAISIZEN → OSL → category → original file description and text preview → catalog → OSL directory → SIG.

Use small bundled collections with original Japanese content appropriate to the circa-1996 setting. Present library material as reading contributions and OSL material as files with meaningful catalog metadata. Existing categories without examples may remain honestly empty.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction decision

Sources were inspected on 2026-10-23:

1. The [DAISIZEN operator memorial](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/index.htm), under its past SIG configuration, separately lists five library categories and six OSL categories. Library categories include seasonal material and forum digests; OSL categories cover tools, databases, utilities and other file material. Confidence is high about the preserved distinctions and labels, but applicability of this entire undated configuration to 1996 is provisional. Its retained mountain forum and account of a 1992 split remain unresolved. Preserve that qualification.
2. The [software author's preserved OSL release listing](https://cba.sakura.ne.jp/soft01/soft_pic.htm) records a release dated 1996-03-17, with separate documentation, program archive and sample files, filenames, dates and numeric size fields. This is strong target-year evidence for differentiated file catalog entries. It concerns CIARI, so its location, numbering and any implied navigation must not be transplanted into DAISIZEN. Original size units and host formatting are not established here.
3. The [linked DAISIZEN participation guide](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/sig_list.htm) remained inaccessible during this pass. Repository research retains earlier observations of mixed 1988/1995 sections and library editorial practice; these are retained findings, not fresh verification. The accessible memorial independently supports proceeding with category browsing.

Accept the memorial's category organization provisionally. Reconstruct category selection, listing, reading, return controls, layouts and all sample content. Reusing numbered category choices and `LIST`/`READ number` is acceptable as an application convention, without claiming authenticated PC-VAN commands. Neither exact terminal transcription nor binary transfer emulation is required for these bounded journeys.

### Repository and implementation history

- `data/pcvan/sig-evidence.json` already distinguishes observed service labels from reconstructed `LIBRARY`/`OSL` entry helpers. Retain this distinction when adding categories and content.
- `src/navigation.ts` owns navigation and its parent stack. `src/main.ts` and `src/commands.ts` separately dispatch forum reads, mail operations, composition and OLT. New reads must remain scoped to their service and must not acquire forum/mail side effects.
- `tests/services.spec.ts` currently requires both services to be empty and rejects numeric selection and `READ 1`. Replace these obsolete expectations while retaining the other service assertions. `tests/sections.spec.ts` protects MAIN destinations, return paths and empty saved boards.
- Closed [Issue #13](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/13) established evidence-qualified service entries; closed [Issue #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33) established useful empty destinations. This increment advances those placeholders with bounded original content. Live repository searches found no open Issues or PRs at inspection time.
- [PR #58](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/58) and `docs/validation.md` report 208 passing tests including the production build. These are existing implementation records; this research graph ran no tests.

Scope is DAISIZEN library and OSL browsing. Conference, login, other information services, AI activity and the application's general historical-calendar policy remain separate work.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] LIBRARY displays the memorial's five category labels, and OSL displays its six category labels, in their respective order. Category-number inputs are documented as reconstructed controls; do not promote them to verified host selectors. Keep the existing service-entry metadata and target-year uncertainty.
- [ ] Provide at least two original library articles across two appropriate reading categories, and at least two original OSL file entries across two appropriate file categories. A seasonal observation article, an original digest, documentation and observation data are suitable examples. Do not copy archived messages, real member identities, images, software or binaries. Do not turn the separate forum named ダーウィン図書館 into the library service.
- [ ] Library lists expose titles and readable article bodies. OSL lists/details expose filename, purpose, date, size with units, and an actual text preview of the bundled example. Document the local size calculation and encoding; do not present modern UTF-8 sizing as authenticated historical transmission size. Any assigned 1996 dates are fictional simulation dates, not claimed historical publication dates.
- [ ] Category → list → item → return works for both services. `HELP` redisplays the current view, applicable `LIST` controls redisplay listings, `BACK` follows the actual parent hierarchy, and `MAIN` clears nested navigation. Re-entering or switching services cannot expose the previous service's category or item. Out-of-range selectors and item numbers leave context intact and give useful guidance.
- [ ] Keep the implementation small and data-driven within existing navigation/collection conventions. Bundled examples are separate from user-authored community records. Browsing must not create forum posts, mail, members or read markers, repopulate intentionally empty saved boards, require handle registration, change real timestamps, or alter backup/import/reset semantics. No storage migration is needed for a static read-only catalog.
- [ ] Keep content in the terminal and preserve Settings return behavior, literal-text rendering, Japanese IME, narrow-screen scrolling, output pacing and skip. Normal terminal output remains concise Japanese; sources, fictional-content disclosures, reconstructed controls and preview-only limitations remain accessible through existing About/Details and documentation.
- [ ] Expose only working browsing actions. File previews do not execute code or claim a completed transfer. No uploads, remote transfers, external accounts, new backend, new AI activity or automatic model downloads are introduced.
- [ ] Extend existing controller/Playwright coverage for both successful journeys, every category destination including empty categories, invalid selections, nested returns, service switching and command scoping. Include a production browser journey through both services and opening/closing Settings while viewing content. Verify that browsing leaves user community records unchanged, allowing ordinary command history/session bookkeeping.
- [ ] Preserve existing MAIN/MITI, forum composition/reply, mail, OLT, storage/consent, IME and terminal regression coverage. Use the repository's existing `npm test` configuration, which includes TypeScript checking and the production build; run `git diff --check`. Record actual commands, results and any failures in the PR/validation record. Do not introduce another test framework.
- [ ] Update README usage, research/provenance and affected About/Details text so the two services are no longer described as identical empty file lists. Clearly distinguish observed categories, cross-SIG catalog evidence and reconstructed interaction/content.

## Optional validation

Additional accessible period manuals or author documentation may refine catalog formatting or category dating. Exact hardware dimensions, real-model output assessment and subjective nostalgic-flow review are not completion gates.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. All acceptance checks are achievable before merge.
